summary_zh: 本页为绘本《蝌蚪的梦想》的标题页，显示了书名、作者、插画师及出版社信息，并配有一只可爱的蝌蚪插图。

page_text_ocr_zh:
池塘里一团亮晶晶的卵孵化了，孵出了许多小蝌蚪，他们摆动着长尾巴，在池塘里游啊游。蝌蚪小斑说：“我长大以后要变成游泳高手，游遍池塘的每个角落，认识不同的朋友。”
蝌蚪的嘴长在头部下方，用细细的齿刮水底或石头上的藻类来吃。
蝌蚪的游泳能力不好，平常很少游动，大部分时间都躲在浅浅的水池底下，安静地休息或吃东西。
page_text_en:
In the pond, a cluster of shiny eggs hatched, giving birth to many tiny tadpoles. They wiggled their long tails and swam around the pond. Tadpole Xiaoban said, "When I grow up, I want to become a swimming champion, swim to every corner of the pond, and make new friends." 
Tadpoles' mouths are located under their heads, and they use fine teeth to scrape algae from the bottom of the water or rocks to eat. 
Tadpoles are not good swimmers; they rarely move and spend most of their time hiding under the shallow pond bottom, resting or eating quietly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了池塘中蝌蚪卵孵化后，小蝌蚪们在水中游动的场景。主角蝌蚪小斑表达了长大后想成为游泳高手的梦想，同时页面通过图文介绍了蝌蚪的进食方式和游泳能力。

page_text_ocr_zh:
摆动尾巴游快一点
蝌蚪小斑遇到了一群大肚鱼，他们摆动尾巴游得好快，小斑羡慕地说：“真希望我的尾巴也可以摆动得和你们一样快，这样我就能变成游泳高手了。”大肚鱼笑着说：“游泳不能只靠尾巴，还要靠鳍，等你长出鳍，就可以游得和我们一样快了。”
大肚鱼靠尾鳍、胸鳍、背鳍、腹鳍、臀鳍等来帮助游泳。
尾鳍
背鳍
胸鳍
臀鳍
腹鳍
蝌蚪生活在水中，跟鱼一样都是用鳃呼吸的。不过，蝌蚪没有鳍，只能靠摆动尾巴游动，所以游不快。
好想赶快长出鳍哦！
page_text_en:
Swim Faster by Wiggling Your Tail
Tadpole Xiaoban met a group of big-bellied fish. They swam very fast by wiggling their tails. Xiaoban said enviously, "I really hope my tail can wiggle as fast as yours, then I could become a swimming champion." The big-bellied fish smiled and said, "Swimming can't rely only on your tail; you also need fins. Once you grow fins, you can swim as fast as us." 
The big-bellied fish use their tail fins, pectoral fins, dorsal fins, ventral fins, and anal fins to help them swim.
Tail fin
Dorsal fin
Pectoral fin
Anal fin
Ventral fin
Tadpoles live in water and, like fish, breathe using gills. However, tadpoles don't have fins and can only swim by wiggling their tails, so they swim slowly.
I really want to grow fins quickly!
summary_zh: 蝌蚪小斑羡慕大肚鱼游得快，大肚鱼告诉它游泳需要鳍，而蝌蚪目前只能靠摆动尾巴游动，因此游得不快。小斑因此渴望快点长出鳍。

page_text_ocr_zh:
长出后腿了
过了几天，蝌蚪小斑长出了两条后腿，
“啊！我没有长鳍，却长出了两条腿，这样
可以游得更快吗？”
蝌蚪的后腿肌肉很
发达，可以帮助它踢
水，让它游得更快。
好想赶快把后
腿练强壮哦！
龙虱是一种水生昆虫，后腿像
船桨一样，善于划水游泳。
小斑失望地蹬了蹬后腿，没想
到却游得比以前快多了！龙虱笑着
对小蝌蚪说：“把后腿练强壮，就可
以游得更快哦！”
page_text_en:
Grew Hind Legs
A few days later, tadpole Xiaoban grew two hind legs.
"Ah! I didn't grow fins, but I grew two legs. Can I swim faster now?"
The muscles in the tadpole's hind legs are very developed, helping it kick water and swim faster.
I really want to quickly strengthen my hind legs!
The diving beetle is an aquatic insect, with hind legs like oars, good at paddling through water.
Xiaoban kicked his hind legs in disappointment, but to his surprise, he swam much faster than before! The diving beetle smiled and said to the little tadpole, "Strengthen your hind legs, and you can swim even faster!"
summary_zh: 蝌蚪小斑长出了后腿，起初以为没有鳍无法游得更快，但在尝试蹬腿后发现游速提升，龙虱鼓励它通过锻炼后腿来增强游泳能力。

page_text_ocr_zh:
长出前腿了
蝌蚪小斑勤快地练习用后腿踢水，希望可以越游越快，
却没想到发生了一件奇怪的事。“啊！没想到我用后腿练游泳，
却练到连前腿都长出来了。”小乌龟听后，笑着说：“多
了两条腿游得更快哦！有前腿支撑，转弯也更容易了。”

乌龟有坚硬的外壳，遇到危险的时候，
可以将脑袋缩进壳里躲避危险。

蝌蚪身体左侧
的前腿是从出
水孔的位置长
出来的。
page_text_en:
Grew Front Legs
Tadpole Xiaoban diligently practiced kicking with his hind legs, hoping to swim faster,
but unexpectedly, something strange happened. "Ah! I didn't expect that practicing swimming with my hind legs
would cause my front legs to grow too!" The little turtle, upon hearing this, smiled and said: "Having
two more legs makes swimming faster! With front legs for support, turning is also easier."

Turtles have hard shells. When facing danger,
they can retract their heads into their shells to avoid danger.

The front legs on the left side of the tadpole's body
grow from the position of the gill slits.
summary_zh: 蝌蚪小斑在练习用后腿游泳时，意外长出了前腿，小乌龟鼓励它，指出前腿有助于游得更快和转弯更灵活。页面还介绍了乌龟的防御机制和蝌蚪前腿的生长位置。

page_text_ocr_zh:
可以离开水上岸了
过了几天，小斑又遇到小乌龟，小乌龟说：“嘿，
小斑，你变得不一样了，要不要和我一起上岸去晒晒太阳啊？”小斑学着小乌龟的样子爬上岸。“呼——我终于
可以大口吸气了！好轻松。”原来，最近小斑常常觉得
喘不过气来，今天离开水，终于可以大口吸气了。

蝌蚪原本用鳃呼吸，
但是长出前腿后，出
水孔被盖住，于是改
用肺和皮肤呼吸，所
以它们有时需要探出
水面去呼吸空气。

蝌蚪
青蛙

等长出前腿后，蝌蚪就开始不
太吃东西了。它的尾巴会越变
越短，用以提供自身生长所需
的营养。而它的嘴巴也会越裂
越开，使它长得更像青蛙。
page_text_en:
Can Leave the Water and Go Ashore

A few days later, Xiaoban met the little turtle again. The little turtle said, “Hey, Xiaoban, you’ve changed! Want to come ashore with me to sunbathe?” Xiaoban copied the little turtle and climbed onto the shore. “Huff——I can finally breathe deeply! So relaxing.” In fact, Xiaoban had often felt short of breath lately. Today, away from the water, it could finally breathe deeply.

Tadpoles originally breathe with gills,
but after growing front legs, the
water outlet is covered, so they
switch to breathing with lungs and skin.
Therefore, they sometimes need to
surface to breathe air.

Tadpole
Frog

After growing front legs, tadpoles start
eating less. Their tails become shorter and shorter,
providing nutrients for their own growth. Their mouths
also split wider and wider, making them look more like frogs.
summary_zh: 蝌蚪小斑长出前腿后，呼吸方式发生变化，开始能离开水面呼吸空气，并在小乌龟的鼓励下尝试上岸晒太阳。页面还解释了蝌蚪在长出前腿后，尾巴变短、嘴巴变宽，逐渐向青蛙形态转变的生理变化。

page_text_ocr_zh:
跳得高、游得快的小青蛙
突然，草丛里跳出了一个黑影，小斑吓得立刻跳回水里，潜到了水底。原来，是一只虎斑蛙伸长了舌头在抓虫。又过了好几天，小斑发现，他现在不仅游得快，还跳得高了，就像虎斑蛙哥哥一样，已经变成水中的游泳高手了。
青蛙属于两栖类，可以生活在水中或陆地上。青蛙的皮肤表面能分泌许多黏液，随时保持湿润状态，还能帮助青蛙呼吸。
雄蛙有鸣囊，可以鼓起发出多种响亮的叫声。
小斑，长大真好！
我现在好想赶快学会用鸣囊唱歌哦！
page_text_en:
Jumping High, Swimming Fast Little Frog
Suddenly, a dark shadow jumped out from the grass. Xiao Ban was scared and immediately jumped back into the water, diving to the bottom. It turned out to be a tiger frog stretching its tongue to catch an insect. After a few more days, Xiao Ban discovered that he not only swam faster but also jumped higher, just like his big brother the tiger frog, and had become a swimming expert in the water.
Frogs are amphibians and can live in water or on land. The skin of frogs secretes a lot of mucus, keeping it moist at all times, and can also help frogs breathe.
Male frogs have vocal sacs that can be inflated to produce various loud calls.
Xiao Ban, growing up is great!
I really want to learn to sing with my vocal sacs as soon as possible!
summary_zh: 蝌蚪小斑在经历身体变化后，已成长为能跳能游的小青蛙，它在池塘中自由活动，并羡慕雄蛙能用鸣囊唱歌，同时页面介绍了青蛙的两栖特性及雄蛙的鸣叫器官。

这次的快乐儿歌在前奏一开始时，使用了木制的打击乐器——刮瓜，以木棒重复敲奏和刷奏的方式来模仿青蛙的叫声，增加演唱的趣味，可以请孩子仔细听听。
page_text_en:
Tadpoles Turn into Frogs
Tadpole, tadpole, big head
Tadpole, tadpole, small mouth
Long tail, round body
Shaking head, wiggling tail, spinning around
Frog, frog, pointed head
Frog, frog, big mouth
Long legs, jumps far
Tongue curled, curls up to the sky
Gua gua, gua gua gua
Tadpoles grow up to become frogs
Gua gua, gua gua gua
The pond's singing king is it
Whispers for Parents
At the beginning of this joyful song, a wooden percussion instrument — the scraper — is used. By repeatedly striking and brushing with a wooden stick, it imitates the frog's croak, adding fun to the singing. Please ask your child to listen carefully.
summary_zh: 本页以儿歌形式总结了蝌蚪变青蛙的全过程，描绘了蝌蚪和青蛙的外形特征与生活习性，并附有给家长的提示，说明儿歌中使用刮瓜模仿青蛙叫声的趣味设计。
本页为插图页面，描绘了一只龙虱在池塘中快速游动的场景，周围有水草、浮萍和小鱼，画面生动展现了水下生态环境，无文字内容。
